What Did Cleopatra REALLY Look Like? #history
candidates.source_description:
Hollywood often portrays Cleopatra as a classic beauty queen, but historical evidence paints a very different picture. As a member of the Ptolemaic dynasty, her ancestry was of Macedonian Greek descent. Based on contemporary Roman coins, ancient marble busts, and historical writings from Plutarch, her power lay far more in her intellect, charm, and presence than conventional beauty. Here is what history tells us about what she actually looked like. What do you think of this reconstruction?
